environment.description: Ktor 2.3.4 microservice deployed on AWS ECS Fargate task with public ALB. Container runs as root with /tmp mounted as standard tmpfs. ALB configured with default listener rules forwarding all traffic to target group on port 8080. No additional middleware or reverse proxy between ALB and application. Container security context: privileged=false, readOnlyRootFilesystem=false. ECS task role has no restrictions on tmp file operations. Response headers are only those set by the application code itself.

config.alb: internet-facing, default rules, no managed rule groups
